inputs.description: Your own RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 or RollerCoaster Tycoon Classic installation folder (the one containing Data/g1.dat or Assets/g1.dat). You import it in OpenRCT2 Touch after installing; the build does not read it.

tools.name: pkg-config
tools.note: Install it with Homebrew: brew install pkg-config

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Xcode iPhoneOS SDK
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

publication.reason: OpenRCT2 Touch publishes source rather than a public IPA (see its README); each player builds and signs their own copy. RollerCoaster Tycoon data is imported in the app.
